description: MFA enrollment flow for the platform frontend: a reusable enrollment modal component, the 403-MFA branch on the platform dashboard, and a proactive MFA entry point in the platform header. Independent of FEAT-002. All code is frontend-only in apps/web; uses the verified backend MFA endpoints without changing them; zero new dependencies (render the backend-provided qrCodeDataUrl PNG in an , no client-side QR library).
steps: Create apps/web/src/components/MfaEnrollment.tsx as a controlled 'use client' modal with props { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; onEnrolled?: () => void }. Return null when !open. Mirror the New Institution modal in apps/web/src/app/platform/page.tsx: fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50 overlay wrapping `bg-white rounded-xl p-6 w-full max-w-md`, role=dialog + aria-modal=true, an X close button (lucide X, aria-label='Close'), and Escape-to-close (follow the keydown pattern in apps/web/src/components/NotificationBell.tsx). Import { api, ApiError } from '@/lib/api'.

Implement an internal step state machine: step in 'scan' | 'verifying' | 'recovery' plus state for error:string, otpauthUri:string, qrCodeDataUrl:string, code:string, recoveryCodes:string[], and a submitting/starting boolean. On open (and on a Start/Try again action) call api.post('/api/auth/mfa/enroll/start', {}) -> { otpauthUri, qrCodeDataUrl }; store both and show the scan step. Idempotent: calling start again just overwrites the secret/QR.

Scan step UI: render the QR as and show otpauthUri as copyable monospace text with a lucide Copy button using navigator.clipboard.writeText(otpauthUri) (mirror the tempPassword copy affordance in platform/page.tsx). Include a labeled 6-digit input (htmlFor/id pair with the 'label' class, className='input', inputMode='numeric', pattern or maxLength 6) bound to code.

Verify step: on submit call api.post('/api/auth/mfa/enroll/verify', { code }) -> { enabled: true, recoveryCodes }. On success store recoveryCodes and move to the recovery step. On failure, if err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 400, show err.data.error inline in a `bg-danger-50 text-danger-700 ... rounded-lg text-sm` box with role='alert' WITHOUT closing the modal; if the message is 'Enrollment not started', offer a button that re-runs start. For other errors show err.message.

Recovery step: list recoveryCodes in a monospace grid, with a prominent warning (warning-* or danger-* styling) stating they are shown only once and must be saved now, a 'Copy all' button using navigator.clipboard.writeText(recoveryCodes.join('\n')), and a Done btn-primary that calls onEnrolled?.() then onClose(). Use lucide icons already in the project (e.g. ShieldCheck, CheckCircle2, Copy, X, Loader2).

Wire the 403-MFA branch in apps/web/src/app/platform/page.tsx: import { ApiError } from '@/lib/api' and MfaEnrollment from '@/components/MfaEnrollment'. Add state mfaRequired:boolean and showMfa:boolean. In load(): set mfaRequired=false at the start alongside setError(''); change the .catch so it inspects the raw error: if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 403 && /mfa/i.test(err.data?.error ?? '')) setMfaRequired(true); else setError(err.message || 'Failed to load platform data'). Keep the existing generic `if (error) return
{error}
`.

On the platform page, before the generic error return, when mfaRequired is true render a dedicated panel using the `card` class titled 'MFA enrollment required' with a short explanation and an 'Enroll now' btn-primary that sets showMfa=true. Mount <MfaEnrollment open={showMfa} onClose={() => setShowMfa(false)} onEnrolled={() => { setShowMfa(false); setMfaRequired(false); load(); }} />.

Add the proactive entry point in apps/web/src/app/platform/layout.tsx (already 'use client', SUPER_ADMIN-only, has a header). Add local useState showMfa, import MfaEnrollment and a lucide ShieldCheck icon, add a header button near the Sign Out button (match the existing `flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-600 hover:...` text-button styling) labeled e.g. 'Enable MFA' that opens the modal, and mount <MfaEnrollment open={showMfa} onClose={() => setShowMfa(false)} /> (no onEnrolled needed here). Keep it minimal; do not add a settings page.
acceptance_criteria: apps/web/src/components/MfaEnrollment.tsx exists and exports a controlled MfaEnrollment component with props open/onClose/onEnrolled.

The component calls POST /api/auth/mfa/enroll/start then POST /api/auth/mfa/enroll/verify via the api wrapper, renders qrCodeDataUrl in an , shows otpauthUri copyable, and displays recoveryCodes once with a copy-all and Done action.
400 responses 'Invalid code' and 'Enrollment not started' are shown inline without closing the modal.

The platform page renders an 'MFA enrollment required' panel with an 'Enroll now' button only when load() fails with ApiError status 403 and data.error matching /mfa/i; all other errors still use the existing generic danger text; after onEnrolled it re-runs load().
The platform header exposes an 'Enable MFA' control that opens the same modal.
No new dependency was added to apps/web/package.json; no backend files were modified.
`npm run build` at c:\campusgate succeeds with no type errors.
verification: Run `npm run build` at c:\campusgate and confirm @campusgate/web compiles with no type errors.
Optionally run `npm run lint -w @campusgate/web` and confirm the TypeScript type-check passes.

Confirm git status shows only apps/web/src/components/MfaEnrollment.tsx, apps/web/src/app/platform/page.tsx, and apps/web/src/app/platform/layout.tsx changed by this feature (plus no .env files, no backend files).
findings: Implemented frontend-only; zero new deps; backend untouched. Component: apps/web/src/components/MfaEnrollment.tsx exports a NAMED (not default) export `MfaEnrollment`. Import with: import { MfaEnrollment } from '@/components/MfaEnrollment'. Prop signature: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; onEnrolled?: () => void }. Returns null when !open. Behavior: on open it auto-calls POST /api/auth/mfa/enroll/start {} (idempotent re-start on the 'Enrollment not started' Try-again link); internal step machine 'scan'|'verifying'|'recovery'; renders qrCodeDataUrl in an (eslint next/no-img-element disabled on that line) plus the otpauthUri as copyable monospace with a lucide Copy button; 6-digit numeric input (id='mfa-code', digits-only sanitized, maxLength 6, Verify disabled until length===6); POST /api/auth/mfa/enroll/verify {code}; 400 errors (Invalid code / Enrollment not started) shown inline via role=alert bg-danger-50 box WITHOUT closing; recovery step shows codes in a 2-col monospace grid with warning-50 banner, 'Copy all' (join '\n'), and Done -> onEnrolled?.() then onClose(). Escape-to-close via keydown listener. platform/page.tsx: added state mfaRequired+showMfa; load() sets mfaRequired=false at start; .catch now checks `err instanceof ApiError && err.status===403 && /mfa/i.test(err.data?.error ?? '')` -> setMfaRequired(true), else existing generic setError; renders a `card` 'MFA enrollment required' panel with 'Enroll now' before the generic `if (error)` return; onEnrolled re-runs load(). platform/layout.tsx: added 'Enable MFA' header text-button (ShieldCheck icon) next to Sign Out inside a new `flex items-center gap-4` wrapper, mounts with no onEnrolled. Verified: `npm run build` at c:\campusgate exits 0, /platform compiles, no type errors. For FEAT-002/WebSocket work: socket.ts WS path must stay `${wsUrl}/ws/connect?token=...` (not touched by this feature).
